html:
Tinted windows are a perfect choice if you want more privacy or to keep the heat out – especially during our hot Aussie summers. But the benefits don’t end there. In addition to car window tinting, we also offer residential and commercial window tinting too. Below, we list the benefits of each that in addition to giving you privacy and a reprieve from the heat, make getting tinted windows a great investment.

For almost 50 years Tint a Car has been supplying Australians with all their tinting needs. In addition to window tinting, we offer state-of-the-art Paint Protection, Paint Protection Film, Car Wraps and car care products. We have ‘No Interest Ever’ financing options available, are members of the Window Film Association of Australia and source our exclusive films from the world’s largest supplier of window film. Here are the reasons why so many people are getting car-tinted windows and home-tinted windows

Benefits of Car Tinted Windows

The main feature that makes car tinted windows a popular choice is their ability to keep out the heat. How car-tinted windows work to block heat can differ depending on the type of film you choose.

Our Octane tint, giving you the darkest legal car tinted windows keeps heat at bay by reflecting it away from the interior of your car. Octane also offers the ultimate in privacy, protecting you, your passengers and any valuables in your car.

Our Spectre tint offers superior heat rejection by utilising innovative ceramic film technology. Spectre also offers the following features:

  • Zero interference to the signals from electronic devices such as mobile phones, satellite navigation, keyless entry, FM, AM and digital radio station reception or tablets
  • Clear, uninterrupted viewing through the glass of the vehicle, both day and night
  • A uniform colour application that looks great
  • Multiple tint shades are available

The class-leading Black Panther tint is our high-performance tint using heat-absorbing nano-ceramic layers that dynamically work together to trap infrared heat, keeping it out of your car. Black Panther also offers the following benefits:

  • 99% UV rejection
  • 56% glare reduction
  • Reinforced vehicle glass increases passenger safety
  • Improved visibility and clarity
  • Higher durability and scratch resistance

Benefits of Home Tinted Windows

Home tinted windows not only keep the heat out during the hotter months, but they also keep the heat in during colder months – giving you better year-round comfort in your home. This makes your home much more energy efficient too which you’ll notice in your power bills. Other benefits of tinted windows for your home include:

  • A safer home with stronger glass that holds together if broken (minimising both injuries and the threat of break-ins)
  • Daytime privacy without having to pull curtains or blinds so you can enjoy natural light throughout the day
  • A glare reduction (no more annoying screen reflections!)
  • Minimising fading of furnishings and flooring in your home

Get A Quote

Call 13 TINT or get in touch with your nearest store to get a quote for car and home tinted windows from your local window tinting team or to find out more.
